title: get_querychanges_since_for_chat CTE ROW_NUMBER() scans all messages in chat
description: The all_in_chat CTE computes ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC) across ALL messages in the chat, not just the new ones. For a chat with 100k messages and maxChanges=10, this still scans 100k rows to compute positions. Acceptable in Phase 1 (single-user, small chats), but will hurt at scale. Mitigation: at Phase 1 chat sizes (<10k messages), this is a sub-millisecond query. Flag for Phase 2 optimization if chats grow large.
